# Shabanu Aliahmad — Skill Growth Tracker

> Personal skill growth tracker for Shabanu Aliahmad — a learning programmer, coder, and website creator. Tracks current skills, learning goals, and progress over time.

## About
- Owner: Shabanu Aliahmad
- Focus: programming, web development, creative storytelling
- Languages: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python, Java
- Tools: Canva, website builders

## Sections
- What I'm Good At — top strengths
- My Skills — live progress bars (auto-increment twice weekly)
- What I Want to Learn — UI/UX Design, AI Tools, Advanced AI
- 1-Year Goal — AI mastery, visual storytelling, writing
